features.name: Large two-handed Japanese sword; retain sufficient two-hand grip.

Actual Arsenal printed14/PDF16 labeled NODACHI and generated detail compared. Very long continuously curved blade, slender point, small guard and long two-hand grip retain large Japanese-sword class and source length balance. Diagonal camera fits the whole sword without foreshortening or cropping. Dark wrap/satin steel and terminal fitting/open lanyard ring are restrained artistic depth/finish choices; absolute dimensions and reverse-side construction are unspecified. RGB white background and native1254 size require later conditioning. Actual matching clay has completely smooth grip/fittings with fine cuts, wrap, fasteners and texture filled; broad blade facets and major boundaries retained. Assigned sole reviewer inspected native/final independent masks, teal views and paired overlay. Genuine frame/guard/ring openings and thin structures preserved; specular metal highlights remain foreground. No clipped tip, missing rail/bar, detached foreground, broad fringe or shadow. Raw RGB unchanged; common crop/scale/offset only. 2048 output is resampled from1254 square, not native2K. Reference approval only.
